# `expected_state.json`

Canonical rendering (schema version 1) of `compose_from_artifacts(base.ompf, tail_a.letl)`, limited to the columns a checkpoint round trip CARRIES — see the README's "Faithful comparison basis" section for what is included and what is excluded, and why.

Every collection is sorted on a total key, so the file does not inherit `HashMap` iteration order.

**Do not edit this file to make a red gate go green.** A red gate means apply/codec semantics changed under a stored artifact; decide explicitly, then regenerate deliberately.
